title: Proper projection and the refinement compositor
statement: For finite-type spaces over the fixed algebraic closure of a finite field, a prime l different from its characteristic, a finite extension E of Q_l, and positive level n+1, let c1,c2 compactify the same quasi-compact map f and let r refine c1 to c2. In the finite and simultaneous-system words of [def-sf-refinement-projection-words], Words.Composition holds: outer proper projection followed by the proper image of inner projection and comp at M tensor P_p1 L equals tensor(comp_M,id) followed by projection for p1. This holds for every unbounded M,L and every realization presentation. It does not involve the refinement mate gamma or either open tensor map.

source.place: composition/refinement sentence; explicit component calculation using Stacks 0B56 and 0DV0

proof.text: Construct the comparison for the composite left adjoint by composing the two tensor comparisons. Apply the proved rightAdjointProjectionMap_comp and rightAdjointProjectionMap_conjugate identities. Use naturality of the conjugate right-adjoint compositor to move the inverse pullback compositor inside the two pushforwards. Specialize tensor/composition coherence from ambientProperOpenPasting to the two actual ambient arrows, represented over the finite field base. Finally transport their composite along r.hom_g. Repeat with the curried actual system tensor comparison and the supplied system compositors.

theorem refinementProjectionProperComposition
    (F : WeilConjectures.FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (_hl : l ≠ F.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (n : ℕ)
    {X Y : Spaces F} {f : X ⟶ Y} [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
    (c₁ c₂ : Compactification f.hom.left) (r : c₁.Refinement c₂) :
    Words.Composition (finiteWords F
      (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))) r) ∧
    ∀ (o : WeilConjectures.IntegralSystemRealization.Operations l E)
      (z : WeilConjectures.IntegralSystemRealization.Realizations l E F o),
      Words.Composition (WeilConjectures.IntegralSystemRealization.RefinementProjection.systemWords
        l E F o z r)
